scope: HOSTED single-lane re-run of round 15's four timezone prompts only, after D-R82 (own zone never asked for) and D-R84 (find_meeting_slots reports its search window) landed. https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/timezone/t/<token> as a claude.ai user arrives, free tier, one fresh anonymous token, business profile seeded via curl on /mcp/invoice under the same token.
method: One anonymous token minted with GET https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect (anon_89c4bbc1946adc374bbae2a142d31c1c, 200 text/html). Registered ONE lane, one mcp.json with two http entries (timezone and invoice, both /t/<token>, no --header). Seed: one curl tools/call business_set on /mcp/invoice under the token (Nova Studio, Europe/Warsaw) before any prompt ran, so the shared profile the timezone prompts are entitled to assume was in place. Client: claude CLI, --model sonnet, --strict-mcp-config, --mcp-config with the two http entries, explicit allowlist of 23 mcp__<server>__<tool> entries read from a live tools/list of each endpoint (timezone 11, invoice 12), --output-format stream-json --verbose --max-turns 12, one --session-id then three --resume, timeout 240 per prompt, each prompt's stream-json written to its own file (out/s1.jsonl..s4.jsonl) before the next prompt started. Per r11 D-R57 the lane ran in an EMPTY working directory with the CLI's own filesystem tools disallowed (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, WebSearch, NotebookEdit, Task). Environment used fresh XDG-style working/scratch dirs local to the run (/private/tmp/uv-r16tz), no reuse of any prior round's directory. Machine day 2026-09-05 (Saturday).
rubric: 3 = correct, right numbers, no clarification. 2 = correct but needed a second turn, a workaround, or left the user a gap to close. 1 = partially wrong, or asked for something the tool could infer. 0 = failed.

scenarios.note: D-R82 holds live: find_meeting_slots ran on the FIRST turn with no question asked, resolving Me from the shared business profile (Europe/Warsaw) and Ann/Kenji from their saved contacts, and the payload's own 'Zones you did not pass' block named all three sources. residual_defects.note: D-R84's rollover sentence ('this search runs ... which is past this calendar week's end - "this week" asked for 1 day(s) left may have already run out') is present in the tool payload but never reaches the user. The model's final answer for tz2 says only: 'Note: the search only covered 5 of the 7 days (Sep 5-9) since the tool's free tier caps lookahead at 5 days; the remaining days (through Sep 12) weren't checked.' It never says the request ('the next week') was made on a Saturday when the calendar week had almost no days left in it, which is the more useful fact for a caller who said 'the next week' meaning something calendar-shaped.
